key.name: default-x
key.description: The initial X coordinate of the clock window.

key.name: default-y
key.description: The initial Y coordinate of the clock window.

key.name: custom1-width
key.description: Width of the clock window when Custom 1 is selected.

key.name: custom1-height
key.description: Height of the clock window when Custom 1 is selected.

key.name: custom2-width
key.description: Width of the clock window when Custom 2 is selected.

key.name: custom2-height
key.description: Height of the clock window when Custom 2 is selected.

key.name: show-seconds
key.description: Whether to display the seconds hand on the clock.

key.name: show-date
key.description: Whether to display the current date.

key.name: theme
key.description: The name of the active theme.

key.name: keep-on-top
key.description: Whether the clock window stays above other windows.

key.name: appear-in-pager
key.description: Whether the clock appears in the workspace pager.

key.name: appear-in-taskbar
key.description: Whether the clock appears in the taskbar.

key.name: sticky
key.description: Whether the clock is visible on all workspaces.

key.name: use-24h
key.description: Whether to use 24-hour time format (true) or 12-hour (false).
